description: Behind-the-meter / gas-fired power inputs for a US data-center market: Henry Hub spot, regional basis differential, and the delivered industrial + electric gas tariff ($/MMBtu), each with its own source label. Pass market=<slug> (e.g. "northern-virginia", "dallas", "phoenix"). AZ, GA, FL), never a substitute price; if the backend switch is ever turned off again, `gas_to_grid_status` carries that reason. ★ DO NOT COMPARE a $/MWh published before 2026-09-27 with one published now — each surface then picked the price its own way, up to 5.5x apart. Do not derive a $/MWh yourself from the $/MMBtu layers for a withheld state without saying that you did. Do NOT use for the electricity grid fuel mix (use get_grid_data).

heat_rate_btu_per_kwh.description: Optional custom generator heat rate in Btu/kWh for the gas-to-grid $/MWh scenario, e.g. 6800 (avg CCGT)

market.description: Market slug (metro), e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, phoenix — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank
